name: Mini map & DPS meter
author: Drandox
description: Shows dungeon walls, gates and glowing chests on a minimap, with ranked party damage and DPS. Drag to move or resize.
longDescription:
### Preview

![Mini map and DPS meter in a dungeon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Drandoxy/DRH-Mod-MiniMap-DPS-Meter/main/docs/images/overview.png)

See the floor layout, chests and your party's damage while you play.

- The map shows walls, enemies and player portraits. The exit room is purple, and breakable walls have purple cracks.
- Chests use their own icons with a colored glow. Gold and collected XP are shown below the map.
- The damage meter shows each player's total damage, percentage of the party's total damage, and DPS. The top player's bar fills the row; the other bars scale against it.
- Player colors come from their names and match between the map and meter.

Press **M** to hide or show both panels. Drag the map header or the damage meter to move it. Use **- / +** beside the compass to zoom, then drag inside the map to look around. Player-follow resumes after four seconds. Positions, sizes and zoom are saved automatically. Hover over either bottom corner and drag to resize it. Both panels hide during loading and floor countdowns.
